title: Samurai Fortune
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: premium illustrated slot-game catalogue title card.
Primary request: Create ONE original polished "Samurai Fortune" key-art image, wide 2:1 landscape, opaque.
Scene/backdrop: lantern-lit Japanese blossom garden at warm sunset, red arched wooden bridge across a misty stream, distant layered mountain castle, rose-pink cherry blossoms framing edges. Burgundy/crimson and charcoal shadows, warm amber/gold light, secondary jade accents. Match the existing game's established bridge/castle/blossom identity; no new religious imagery.
Subject: ONE elegant forged katana displayed on a low dark-lacquer sword stand, polished gently curved steel blade, navy-blue and gold diamond-wrapped handle, circular ornate gold guard and small red tassel. Full blade tip, hilt and tassel visible, detailed yet restrained. No warrior, no person, no masks or extra weapons.
Composition/framing: WIDE2:1. Large two-line title centered in upper-middle over quiet dark burgundy mist. Compact katana/stand lies diagonally across lower-middle below words, as supporting focal subject. All title letters and entire katana/stand fit inside x15–85%, y22–80%; wide generous outer margins. Never crop the sword or title. Background bridge and blossom branches create scene depth and may extend to edges.
Style/medium: original sophisticated professionally painted game key art, refined craftsmanship, tangible lacquer, silk, steel and petals, soft atmospheric depth and restrained cinematic highlights, cohesive premium catalogue.
Text (verbatim): "Samurai Fortune". Exactly these two words once, on two centered lines, large cream-gold serif lettering with restrained carved/beveled edges and strong contrast; readable at256x128. No Japanese letters or other writing on lanterns, blade or buildings.
Constraints: no extra slogans, payout claims, reels/spin buttons/fake UI, logos/watermarks, cash or coin piles, no unrelated cultural additions. One image only.
editPrompts:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the edit target, Samurai Fortune title card.
Change ONLY the katana, its tassel and dark-lacquer display stand as one group: shrink them to90% of current size around the group's center, preserving angle and position, so the entire blade tip, handle, tassel and stand fit x18–86%, y55–82%. Repaint exposed stone shelf and reflections to match. Preserve exact title "Samurai Fortune" and its size/position, cherry blossoms, red bridge, castle, lantern light, palette and wide 2:1 opaque canvas unchanged. No new props, words, logos or characters.

visualCheck.fullSize: Inspected final master and 768x384 WebP. Exact Samurai Fortune title; forged katana with navy/gold hilt and red tassel, blossom garden, red bridge, lanterns and mountain castle preserve existing identity. No new warrior/deity, writing on lanterns, extra copy, fake UI or claims.
visualCheck.thumbnail256x128: Inspected256x128. Both title words crisp and katana/stand readable as distinct focal prop.
visualCheck.crop: Title and entire sword, blade tip, handle, stand and tassel fit central80%width/70%height after targeted group-size edit.
